# has perceived condition

A standpoint-indexed perceived value about the ambient conditions, expressed as a SensoryPerception in a MentalReferenceFrame. Non-functional: multiple perceivers may produce competing perceptions, and those claims coexist rather than collapse (Principle 9).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasPerceivedCondition>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:hasPerceivedCondition`  

*object property* · domain `gmeow:SensoryEnvironment` · range `gmeow:SensoryPerception`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/sensory-environment>
